en.text: Backtested from June 2007 to the June 2021 launch, the JOJO.Index returned 548.45%. High yield: 106.35%. Long Treasuries: 150.56%. Live since launch: -7.23%. High yield: +18.84%. Same rules, very different era. Rising rates changed the math for the defensive sleeve.

zh.text: 不。德國的TARGET2債權基本上是高債務外圍國家人為債息上限及貨幣大幅高估的對應物。這無法輕算消。若沒有這些債權，外圍貨幣已經大幅貶值，當然它們有一天仍可能這樣做…

en.text: No. Germany’s TARGET2 claims are basically the counterpart to artificial yield caps and big currency overvaluations on the high-debt periphery. There is no netting this out. Without these claims, periphery currencies would have devalued massively and of course they still might one day…

zh.text: Scott Redler (@RedDogT3) 不買入回調，認為市場在選舉前顯示嚴重弱勢跡象，整體市場僅較高點回落約4%，不足以啟動其「血洗街頭」策略（通常在較高點回落5–7%時啟動）。$SPY 給出經典Red Dog反轉賣出信號，嘗試突破失敗後全天賣出，$750/$749區域關鍵，下方支撐至200日均線。$QQQ 領先下行，一個月前曾創新高，現測試200日EMA，收盤低於$683.45為警示。$AAPL 接近100日均線約$323/$321，或有戰術性買入機會，但須等確立低點後再考慮，勿盲目接飛刀。遠離$PLTR，因突破失敗後突破楔形形態，技術損傷顯著，$163為重要參考，200日均線亦受關注。$TSLA 顯示相對強勢，在重新收復$387時買入作為波段，止損$387（主動交易者可用昨日$397低點），若能撐過選舉或維持相對跑贏。不追逐$NVDA/半導體反彈，昨日再次推升失敗並收近低點，寧願在強勢時賣出，關注200日均線及$205區域。$SNDK 仍技術性跌破200日均線，$MU 開始顯弱。許多圖表已破，包括$NBIS及$ASTS等前市場領導股，因假突破及跌破8/21日均線。並非每個回調都是買入機會，在選舉不確定性下控制風險。

en.text: Scott Redler (@RedDogT3) is not buying the dip, citing serious market weakness ahead of the election with the broader market only about 4% off highs, insufficient for his "blood in the streets" strategy which activates at 5–7% below highs. $SPY gave a classic Red Dog Reversal sell signal after failing to hold higher and selling off, with $750/$749 critical and support at the 200-day MA. $QQQ is leading lower, testing its 200-day EMA after ATHs a month ago, with a close below $683.45 a warning. $AAPL is approaching its 100-day MA around $323/$321, with possible tactical buy after establishing a low but not catching a falling knife. Staying away from $PLTR after breaking its wedge pattern post failed breakout, with $163 an important reference and 200-day MA in focus. $TSLA shows relative strength; bought on reclaim of $387 as a swing with stop at $387 (or $397 low for active traders), and if it holds through election could outperform. Not chasing $NVDA/semis bounce after another push-through failure and close near lows; prefers selling into strength with 200-day MA and $205 area in focus. $SNDK remains broken below 200-day, $MU beginning to weaken. Many broken charts including $NBIS and $ASTS after false breakouts and breakdowns below 8/21-day MAs. Not every dip is a buying opportunity; control risk amid election uncertainty.
